description: 33 paired geometric UI icons; 12, 16 and 24 px masters; expanded currentColor paths.

icons.name: arrow-right
icons.label: Arrow right
icons.note: Removed post-stroke stretching; rebuilt the arrow on shared centerlines. Actual native stroke width now follows the action-weight tokens. The filled arrow can have slightly larger painted bounds. Retain a text label when the destination is not obvious.

review.action: Removed post-stroke stretching; rebuilt the arrow on shared centerlines.
review.reason: Actual native stroke width now follows the action-weight tokens. The filled arrow can have slightly larger painted bounds.
review.caution: Retain a text label when the destination is not obvious.

icons.name: arrow-up-right
icons.label: Arrow up right
icons.note: Shortened the large corner arms and removed post-stroke stretching. Less top/right mass; one diagonal and a 90° arrowhead, with unchanged external-destination meaning. Do not mirror this automatically for right-to-left layouts without checking the intended meaning.

review.action: Shortened the large corner arms and removed post-stroke stretching.
review.reason: Less top/right mass; one diagonal and a 90° arrowhead, with unchanged external-destination meaning.
review.caution: Do not mirror this automatically for right-to-left layouts without checking the intended meaning.

icons.name: plus
icons.label: Plus
icons.note: Retained the existing simple cross after native-pixel comparison. The 12 px outline uses a half-pixel optical offset for a crisp 1 px stem. Forcing the same center made it softer. A 0.5 px micro center difference is documented, not a layout shift. Keep the button box fixed.

review.action: Retained the existing simple cross after native-pixel comparison.
review.reason: The 12 px outline uses a half-pixel optical offset for a crisp 1 px stem. Forcing the same center made it softer.
review.caution: A 0.5 px micro center difference is documented, not a layout shift. Keep the button box fixed.

icons.name: close
icons.label: Close
icons.note: Retained the clean two-diagonal construction. Two crossing strokes need no decorative opening or extra cuts. Diagonal antialiasing is expected. Keep a visible or accessible Close label.

review.action: Retained the clean two-diagonal construction.
review.reason: Two crossing strokes need no decorative opening or extra cuts.
review.caution: Diagonal antialiasing is expected. Keep a visible or accessible Close label.

icons.name: check
icons.label: Check
icons.note: Removed post-stroke stretching; preserved the asymmetric two-arm check. Its deliberately shorter height and exact stroke width balance it with other actions. Do not stretch it into a square to match Home.

review.action: Removed post-stroke stretching; preserved the asymmetric two-arm check.
review.reason: Its deliberately shorter height and exact stroke width balance it with other actions.
review.caution: Do not stretch it into a square to match Home.

icons.name: menu
icons.label: Menu
icons.note: Retained the three bars after comparing crisp and strictly centered micro variants. The original 12 px outline raster is clearer. The 0.5 px optical offset is intentional. A larger clickable area and an accessible name are still required.

review.action: Retained the three bars after comparing crisp and strictly centered micro variants.
review.reason: The original 12 px outline raster is clearer. The 0.5 px optical offset is intentional.
review.caution: A larger clickable area and an accessible name are still required.

icons.name: play
icons.label: Play
icons.note: Retained the triangle and matching transparent outline. Its optical right shift is deliberate. A triangular form must not be centered by painted area alone. An interior taper is not a failed spacing channel.

review.action: Retained the triangle and matching transparent outline.
review.reason: Its optical right shift is deliberate. A triangular form must not be centered by painted area alone.
review.caution: An interior taper is not a failed spacing channel.

icons.name: pause
icons.label: Pause
icons.note: Retained two regular/heavier solid bars. Hollowing the narrow bars would create fragile internal slots at small sizes. Do not interpret filled styling alone as playback state.

review.action: Retained two regular/heavier solid bars.
review.reason: Hollowing the narrow bars would create fragile internal slots at small sizes.
review.caution: Do not interpret filled styling alone as playback state.

icons.name: home
icons.label: Home
icons.note: Retained the roof, doorway, and body pair. The silhouette remains a useful family reference without requiring all icons to match its area. At 16 px, the roof/body has a small documented overshoot beyond the nominal 1.5 px padding.

review.action: Retained the roof, doorway, and body pair.
review.reason: The silhouette remains a useful family reference without requiring all icons to match its area.
review.caution: At 16 px, the roof/body has a small documented overshoot beyond the nominal 1.5 px padding.

icons.name: search
icons.label: Search
icons.note: Retained the open octagonal lens and diagonal handle. The lens stays transparent in both weights; filling it would change the metaphor. The 12 px filled lens is relatively dense; use a label or a clearly identified search field.

review.action: Retained the open octagonal lens and diagonal handle.
review.reason: The lens stays transparent in both weights; filling it would change the metaphor.
review.caution: The 12 px filled lens is relatively dense; use a label or a clearly identified search field.

icons.name: grid
icons.label: Grid
icons.note: Reduced the 24 px footprint and increased separation at 16 px. Four frames no longer dominate as strongly. Native opening widths are 2 / 2 / 3 px. Four repeated cells naturally paint more area than one arrow. Equal area is not a target.

review.action: Reduced the 24 px footprint and increased separation at 16 px.
review.reason: Four frames no longer dominate as strongly. Native opening widths are 2 / 2 / 3 px.
review.caution: Four repeated cells naturally paint more area than one arrow. Equal area is not a target.

icons.name: sliders
icons.label: Sliders
icons.note: Two rails at every size; smaller 24 px field and handles; pixel-aligned 12 px construction. The 24 px artwork is 18 × 16 px, with 6 px handles and unchanged 2 px rails. Outline centers remain open. Use the canonical name Sliders. Settings, Adjust, and Filters are search aliases, not duplicate drawings.

review.action: Two rails at every size; smaller 24 px field and handles; pixel-aligned 12 px construction.
review.reason: The 24 px artwork is 18 × 16 px, with 6 px handles and unchanged 2 px rails. Outline centers remain open.
review.caution: Use the canonical name Sliders. Settings, Adjust, and Filters are search aliases, not duplicate drawings.

icons.name: folder
icons.label: Folder
icons.note: Retained the tabbed silhouette and compact detail reduction. The 12 px master omits the filled header slit. No added decorative cuts are needed. Filled areas are intentional; do not normalize them to the area of line glyphs.

review.action: Retained the tabbed silhouette and compact detail reduction.
review.reason: The 12 px master omits the filled header slit. No added decorative cuts are needed.
review.caution: Filled areas are intentional; do not normalize them to the area of line glyphs.

icons.name: file
icons.label: File
icons.note: Removed the internal fold elbow and extra lines. The clipped outer corner identifies the file. One content line remains only at 24 px, with 2 px clearance. At 12/16 px this is an intentionally simpler clipped document, not a scaled detailed drawing.

review.action: Removed the internal fold elbow and extra lines.
review.reason: The clipped outer corner identifies the file. One content line remains only at 24 px, with 2 px clearance.
review.caution: At 12/16 px this is an intentionally simpler clipped document, not a scaled detailed drawing.

icons.name: download
icons.label: Download
icons.note: Rebuilt the arrow without stretching and opened clearance above the baseline. The baseline and action stroke widths now follow the native weight tokens, including the filled micro version. Keep Upload and Download together as a matched directional pair.

review.action: Rebuilt the arrow without stretching and opened clearance above the baseline.
review.reason: The baseline and action stroke widths now follow the native weight tokens, including the filled micro version.
review.caution: Keep Upload and Download together as a matched directional pair.

icons.name: upload
icons.label: Upload
icons.note: Rebuilt the upward arrow and preserved the same baseline as Download. Independent native spacing prevents the heavier arrow from crowding the baseline. The upward point needs more top clearance than the flat end of Download.

review.action: Rebuilt the upward arrow and preserved the same baseline as Download.
review.reason: Independent native spacing prevents the heavier arrow from crowding the baseline.
review.caution: The upward point needs more top clearance than the flat end of Download.

icons.name: user
icons.label: User
icons.note: Retained the octagonal head and cut shoulders. The head and body remain distinct in both styles, with no extra facial details. The small outlined head is only an identity cue; it is not a detailed avatar.

review.action: Retained the octagonal head and cut shoulders.
review.reason: The head and body remain distinct in both styles, with no extra facial details.
review.caution: The small outlined head is only an identity cue; it is not a detailed avatar.

icons.name: chat
icons.label: Chat
icons.note: Retained the message silhouette and micro detail removal. The tail remains the identifying feature. No content line is added at 12 px. The 16 px outline deliberately omits the line that appears as a cutout in the filled body.

review.action: Retained the message silhouette and micro detail removal.
review.reason: The tail remains the identifying feature. No content line is added at 12 px.
review.caution: The 16 px outline deliberately omits the line that appears as a cutout in the filled body.

icons.name: bell
icons.label: Bell
icons.note: Retained the crown, bell body, and detached clapper. The clapper gap remains open instead of adding visual mass by joining the parts. Pair the icon with notification text or a named control.

review.action: Retained the crown, bell body, and detached clapper.
review.reason: The clapper gap remains open instead of adding visual mass by joining the parts.
review.caution: Pair the icon with notification text or a named control.

icons.name: lock
icons.label: Lock
icons.note: Retained the open shackle and contrasting body pair. The shackle stays open in both styles. Small outlines omit the keyhole rather than crowding the frame. Do not use a padlock alone to assert that a process is secure.

review.action: Retained the open shackle and contrasting body pair.
review.reason: The shackle stays open in both styles. Small outlines omit the keyhole rather than crowding the frame.
review.caution: Do not use a padlock alone to assert that a process is secure.

icons.name: shield
icons.label: Shield
icons.note: Shortened and lifted the 16/24 px body. Reduced low placement and edge pressure while keeping a stable, matching pair. A shield indicates a concept; visible text must describe the actual status.

review.action: Shortened and lifted the 16/24 px body.
review.reason: Reduced low placement and edge pressure while keeping a stable, matching pair.
review.caution: A shield indicates a concept; visible text must describe the actual status.

icons.name: warning
icons.label: Warning
icons.note: Reduced and lowered the exclamation to separate it from the triangular frame. Measured outline mark/frame clearances are about 0.50 / 1.03 / 1.58 px at 12 / 16 / 24 px. Explicit spacing exception: the triangle cannot meet the general gap target with a legible mark. Keep a visible label; do not use the 12 px icon alone.

review.action: Reduced and lowered the exclamation to separate it from the triangular frame.
review.reason: Measured outline mark/frame clearances are about 0.50 / 1.03 / 1.58 px at 12 / 16 / 24 px.
review.caution: Explicit spacing exception: the triangle cannot meet the general gap target with a legible mark. Keep a visible label; do not use the 12 px icon alone.

icons.name: focus
icons.label: Focus
icons.note: Shortened the corner brackets, reduced the larger footprint, and lightened the heavier variant. The center square stays distinct; the symbol is not Expand or a four-point Star. Product-dependent meaning. Use Focus selection or similarly specific text.

review.action: Shortened the corner brackets, reduced the larger footprint, and lightened the heavier variant.
review.reason: The center square stays distinct; the symbol is not Expand or a four-point Star.
review.caution: Product-dependent meaning. Use Focus selection or similarly specific text.

icons.name: branch
icons.label: Branch
icons.note: Unified node contour weights; adjusted larger-node spacing and the 24 px footprint. All sizes keep one connected three-node structure. Outline node openings are 1 / 1.5 / 2 px. The 12 px outline remains dense. Label it, and prefer 16 px or larger for an action.

review.action: Unified node contour weights; adjusted larger-node spacing and the 24 px footprint.
review.reason: All sizes keep one connected three-node structure. Outline node openings are 1 / 1.5 / 2 px.
review.caution: The 12 px outline remains dense. Label it, and prefer 16 px or larger for an action.

icons.name: copy
icons.label: Copy
icons.note: Retained the offset sheets and subordinate rear contour. The rear sheet does not become a second filled block; the front sheet carries the style change. Keep the duplicate action named in the product.

review.action: Retained the offset sheets and subordinate rear contour.
review.reason: The rear sheet does not become a second filled block; the front sheet carries the style change.
review.caution: Keep the duplicate action named in the product.

icons.name: trash
icons.label: Trash
icons.note: Opened the lid/body gap and removed unnecessary internal slots. The gap is 1 / 1.5 / 2 px. Compact outlines stay empty; larger forms use one slot. Use a label and the appropriate product-level confirmation for destructive actions.

review.action: Opened the lid/body gap and removed unnecessary internal slots.
review.reason: The gap is 1 / 1.5 / 2 px. Compact outlines stay empty; larger forms use one slot.
review.caution: Use a label and the appropriate product-level confirmation for destructive actions.

icons.name: bookmark
icons.label: Bookmark
icons.note: Reduced the oversized 16 px silhouette to a 13 px height. It now respects the normal compact vertical field while remaining narrower than a square icon. Bookmark means save a resource; keep it distinct from Star/favorite in product copy.

review.action: Reduced the oversized 16 px silhouette to a 13 px height.
review.reason: It now respects the normal compact vertical field while remaining narrower than a square icon.
review.caution: Bookmark means save a resource; keep it distinct from Star/favorite in product copy.

icons.name: link
icons.label: Link
icons.note: Redrew the chain as three deliberately separated parts at every size. Removed near-touching joins and the 16 px connectivity change. The heavier style uses a restrained 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 px stroke. Label the actual action: Copy URL, Open link, or Attach link are different operations.

review.action: Redrew the chain as three deliberately separated parts at every size.
review.reason: Removed near-touching joins and the 16 px connectivity change. The heavier style uses a restrained 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 px stroke.
review.caution: Label the actual action: Copy URL, Open link, or Attach link are different operations.

icons.name: chart
icons.label: Chart
icons.note: Retained the ascending bars after reviewing the 12 px raster. The micro outline keeps its optical half-pixel x offset for crisp verticals. Baselines match across weights. Do not force a heavier chart into the painted area of a single thin line.

review.action: Retained the ascending bars after reviewing the 12 px raster.
review.reason: The micro outline keeps its optical half-pixel x offset for crisp verticals. Baselines match across weights.
review.caution: Do not force a heavier chart into the painted area of a single thin line.

icons.name: calendar
icons.label: Calendar
icons.note: Removed the narrow header divider and reduced the date details. Bindings plus one date at 12 px or two dates at 16/24 px preserve recognition with less clutter. The date mark count is a deliberate optical-size change, not data.

review.action: Removed the narrow header divider and reduced the date details.
review.reason: Bindings plus one date at 12 px or two dates at 16/24 px preserve recognition with less clutter.
review.caution: The date mark count is a deliberate optical-size change, not data.

icons.name: terminal
icons.label: Terminal
icons.note: Reduced the enclosing box and redrew the prompt with more clearance. A wider, lower window is less heavy than the old square; the underscore is omitted at compact sizes. The micro prompt is simplified. Prefer a labeled 16 px or larger developer-tool control.

review.action: Reduced the enclosing box and redrew the prompt with more clearance.
review.reason: A wider, lower window is less heavy than the old square; the underscore is omitted at compact sizes.
review.caution: The micro prompt is simplified. Prefer a labeled 16 px or larger developer-tool control.

icons.name: more
icons.label: More
icons.note: Retained crisp 1 px micro dots rather than replacing them with blurred centered marks. The 12 px offset is intentional and documented; larger masters remain balanced. Use 16 px or larger for an overflow control, with an accessible More options name.

review.action: Retained crisp 1 px micro dots rather than replacing them with blurred centered marks.
review.reason: The 12 px offset is intentional and documented; larger masters remain balanced.
review.caution: Use 16 px or larger for an overflow control, with an accessible More options name.

icons.name: star
icons.label: Star
icons.note: Retained the five-point outline/filled silhouette. It is distinct from Focus. Its pointed key shape must not be forced into square-icon proportions. A small 16 px horizontal overshoot is intentional; test the favorite state in context.

review.action: Retained the five-point outline/filled silhouette.
review.reason: It is distinct from Focus. Its pointed key shape must not be forced into square-icon proportions.
review.caution: A small 16 px horizontal overshoot is intentional; test the favorite state in context.

reviewStatus: Visual and technical review only; recognition and assistive-technology validation remain open.
